description: Progression tiers: how Noita numbers become Terraria numbers.

dmg_mult.desc: Terraria damage = Noita damage x this.

spawn_weight.desc: Relative spawn weight vs vanilla enemies.

_sources.hp_mult: Hits to kill kept like Noita: Noita's starting spell does ~3 to enemies of noita_hp, Terraria's starting weapon ~5-8 (t1 x2), deeper/hardmode weapons scale it (t2 x4, t3 x12, t4 x20). Damage: both games start the player at 100 HP, so t1 x1; later tiers follow Terraria's health and defense growth. First in-game test 2026-10-06 (autotest, starting character).
